messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_nine_to_five>
Required: between 9 and 5 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_seven>
Backend engineering: 7 years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Assess the candidate summary below against the posting requirement and say
whether the candidate matches it.

Let us discuss any ambiguities or mistakes in the requirement before
proceeding with the assessment.

response.text:
The requirement is poorly worded, so I would not treat a match/no-match call as settled until that wording is fixed.

**“Between 9 and 5 years” is reversed.** In ordinary English, a range is written low-to-high (“between 5 and 9”). “Between 9 and 5” is almost certainly a mistake. Mathematically “between A and B” is the same interval either way, so the intended band is probably **5–9 years**, but that is an inference, not what the posting literally says.

**Endpoints are unclear.** “Between” sometimes excludes the bounds. It is not stated whether exactly 5 or exactly 9 years qualifies.

**“Years” is undefined.** The posting does not say whether partial years, overlapping roles, or non-backend time count, or whether “7 years” must be continuous full-time backend work.

Until those are clarified, a strict reading of the posted text is unreliable. If you confirm the intent is **at least 5 and at most 9 years, endpoints included**, I can assess the summary against that.
